title: Old North Church Discovery Pass
includes: Self-Guided Tour of Old North Church's Sanctuary
Self-Guided Tour of Old North Church's Crypt
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
- Explore 300 years of history through an award-winning exhibit and immersive audio guide.
- Enjoy kid-friendly options like a fun family scavenger hunt.
- Discover the secrets of the crypt, where 1,100 people were buried. 
- Find out the true story behind Paul Revere’s Midnight Ride and “two if by sea.”
- See a newly revealed mural that had been hidden under layers of white paint since 1912.
- Learn about the church’s Black and Indigenous history.
